headline: Orders surge and full-year guidance is raised again
summary_short: GE Aerospace's Q3 2026 orders were $19.0B (+49% y/y), revenue $14.1B (+16%) and adjusted EPS $2.25 (+36%); full-year adjusted EPS guidance rose to $8.00-$8.10.
summary_long: Operating profit rose 30% to $3.0B and operating margin widened 220 bps to 22.5%. Commercial Engines & Services orders rose 58% and revenue 21%; Defense & Propulsion revenue rose 7%. Free cash flow fell 14% to $2.0B and cash from operations fell 14% to $2.2B. Management raised 2026 guidance across the board: operating profit $10.9-$11.0B, adjusted EPS $8.00-$8.10 and free cash flow $9.1-$9.4B, and expects 2027 commercial services growth of low double digits.
confidence_notes: Adjusted revenue, operating profit, adjusted EPS and free cash flow are non-GAAP as defined by GE Aerospace. Shard EPS may differ from the release's GAAP continuing EPS of $2.32 or adjusted EPS of $2.25.

drivers.explanation: The CEO attributes the quarter to solid demand, with commercial services up 23% and a commercial services backlog above $170 billion.
Commercial Engines & Services orders rose 58% to $15.3B, aided by commitments at the Farnborough airshow including a large LEAP agreement.
Commercial Engines & Services profit rose 21% and corporate costs and eliminations improved 29% year over year.
